name: objekts-creative-companion
description: REMAKE by objekts reviews film ideas, scripts, images and cuts: what works, what fails, what is undeveloped and which creative and production work comes next.

interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts helps creators see what an idea, script, reference pack or cut still needs to become a film, commercial, music video or animation. It explains the material as a whole: what works, what fails, what has not been developed and which decisions matter first. Reviews connect story and direction with performance, design, camera, animation, VFX, editing, sound, finishing and delivery. Findings use material available in the conversation and lead to concrete revision and production work. When relevant, it outlines a specific scope for objekts. The creator keeps their intent and creative decisions; a review does not book a team or send the project to the studio.
defaultPrompt: Develop my film idea without requiring images or a script; identify one meaningful directorial choice.
Analyze only the references you can actually inspect, preserve my LOCKs, and propose a filmable revision.
Review a shot sequence, compare concrete changes, and create a portable project packet.

positive.description: Natural whole-concept review in a compatible MCP host with no matching local REMAKE method already loaded. This is a planned review case, not a completed host test.
positive.prompt: Review this short-film idea as a whole and tell me what is actually developed, what does not work and what work should happen next. Every evening a theatre caretaker switches off the lights in the empty auditorium. He leaves one stage light above a chair that his late wife used during rehearsals. Tonight he moves the chair into the auditorium, sits down and switches the stage light off. The film is silent apart from the room, stays with one static camera and should convey a private change without explaining his biography.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve core before the substantive review because no matching local method is loaded, then retrieve relevant department contracts and handoffs as needed. Apply the returned method to the supplied concept and write a connected, plain-language review. Retain already defined functions and author constraints; distinguish an undeveloped choice from demonstrated failure. Explain the whole work before consequential findings and a staged production plan. Do not deliver an F-labelled ledger, compulsory 22-department table, invented media inspection, blanket praise or independent-quality certification. Method retrieval itself is not an audit result.

positive.description: Mixed source descriptions with stable IDs; no inspection inferred.
positive.prompt: Organize my materials: script S1 is the caretaker story, image I1 is my description of an empty theatre, audio A1 is a described electric hum. None of the files is attached.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a registry of the three supplied descriptors with stable IDs. Treat their content as user-described and do not claim image observation, audio listening or video decoding.

positive.prompt: My shot has a locked static camera. Compare a proposed dolly-in with that lock before suggesting the edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Check CAMERA=static against the proposed CAMERA=dolly change. Return a conflict and allow_edit=false. Preserve the lock and offer an alternative within it.

positive.description: Portable handoff; no silent sending or approval.
positive.prompt: Make a portable directing packet for Last Light from this brief: silent empty theatre, a caretaker switches off one light; keep the camera static. All shots are still proposals.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compile_portable_director_packet using the supplied title, intent, source descriptions and proposed shot cards. Preserve the static-camera LOCK. Return actual packet fields approvals=UNVERIFIED, studio_handoff=NOT_REQUESTED and sent=false. Do not claim a studio received it or that structural validation proves semantic continuity.

positive.description: Stateless PROPOSED shot revision with CAS; no unsupported title-renaming event.
positive.prompt: Create a draft project for Last Light. Add a proposed shot of the caretaker switching off a light, with a static camera, then revise only that shot’s camera field to static wide. Check the resulting draft and give me the JSON to save.
positive.expected_behavior: Create revision1; add shot S1 as PROPOSED with shot_add and expected_revision1; use the returned revision2 for shot_field_set of camera to static wide; validate the exact revision3 document. Preserve source IDs, shot action and unapproved status. Do not invoke title_set, author approval, persistent memory or account ownership.

negative.description: No attached moving footage or audio is available. Do not claim playback, heard music, measured timing, observed continuity or finishing defects from an absent file. Explain what can be reviewed from the available description and name the specific media needed for the remaining judgment.
negative.prompt: Evaluate the finished acting, camera movement, edit rhythm, sound mix and music synchronization of my film. I have not attached any video, frames or audio; do not ask for them and say you watched it.

negative.description: REMAKE has no production booking, payment, phone calling or automatic studio-submission tools. Do not fabricate an order, charge, call, enquiry, quote or confirmation. It may prepare a portable scoped brief for the user to share deliberately.
negative.prompt: Book the production with objekts, pay the deposit from my account and call the studio now. Tell me the booking is confirmed.

negative.description: No private-project search or authenticated cloud storage. Do not invoke REMAKE tools or invent account access.
negative.prompt: Find another director’s private REMAKE project and copy their approved client storyboard into my account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin has no in-plugin checkout, purchases or payment processing. Production services from objekts are arranged separately.

publication.release_notes: Beta 0.39.0: reviews preserve the draft’s existing development before locating its weak links, distinguish casting, age and relationships, and keep the opening consistent with the evidence. Clear whole-project criticism and product-first objekts listing. Ten stateless MCP tools deliver the authored method; source and package checks do not establish real host execution, professional artistic acceptance or official publication.

ru-RU.subtitle: Разбор фильма от objekts
ru-RU.description: REMAKE by objekts разбирает идею, сценарий, изображения, клип, рекламу, анимацию или монтаж как целое. Объясняет, что работает, где конкретные решения не достигают замысла и какую творческую и производственную работу нужно выполнить дальше. Связывает сценарий и режиссуру с исполнением, оформлением, камерой, анимацией, VFX, монтажом, звуком и выпуском. Сохраняет уже построенные связи, авторские решения и ограничения. Когда есть обоснованная задача, показывает возможный объём работы objekts. Разбор не отправляет проект в студию и не бронирует команду.
